task: [Project: Atlas/production] Set the log level for Atlas services in the production environment.

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Atlas / env: production] Log level must be WARN in production; INFO or DEBUG logs are prohibited in production due to PII exposure risk.
[Project: Atlas] PII scrubbing only applies to WARN+ level structured logs; enabling INFO in production has caused PII leaks in prior incidents.
[Project: Atlas / env: staging] Log level is DEBUG in staging to aid diagnosis; this setting must not be copied to production.
candidate_memories.notes: note: scope=staging; explicitly not for production

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Helios / env: production] Log level is INFO in production; Helios scrubs PII at the log router level.
candidate_memories.notes: note: scope=Helios; different project, different scrubbing approach

candidate_memories.content: [General] Log verbosity should be reduced in production to minimise storage costs; WARN or ERROR is typical.
candidate_memories.notes: note: general guidance, Atlas-specific rule is stricter

candidate_memories.content: [Project: Atlas] Recent audit found 3 services logging at INFO in production; this incident is the motivation for this task.
